# Ashen Crossing

- Chapter: 2

## Scene 1: LANDFALL ON THE SCORCHED PLAIN

> A shuttle sets down at the edge of a cracked white plain. The star hangs huge and red above it.

**KARAX**: [Serious 40]The star surges every few minutes.[/Serious] Out in the open, the heat will burn through any shield.

**ZERATUL**: Then I will walk in the shadows it leaves.

**KARAX**: The Overhang and the Rock Arch will shelter you. After that, the temple gate.

**ARTANIS**: Go carefully, old friend. We need what lies in that temple.

## Scene 2: BETWEEN THE SURGES

> The ground glows as a surge rolls over the plain, then dims.

**KARAX**: Another surge is building. Find cover.

**ZERATUL**: [Fear 20]I feel it.[/Fear]

## Scene 3: THE TEMPLE GATE

> Zeratul steps out of the heat into the cool shade of the gate.

**ZERATUL**: [Happy 30]I have reached the temple.[/Happy]

**ARTANIS**: En taro Tassadar. Bring it home.
